source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When event loading produces a recurrence summary, CalendarDialog sets the date row repeats attribute. When no summary exists, it removes that attribute; clearData also removes it. Start/end attributes have a separate local contract and are not cleared in the same block. This prevents an earlier repeating event from supplying the next event’s recurrence label. The changed tests directly inspect transferred attributes and reset behavior, not every timezone or recurrence formatter. No Calendar test ran.
title: Reused event date rows must clear an absent recurrence summary
